text:
Devon: morning async standup — quick notes: what I did / blockers / today
Devon: Did: pushed route-policy change to canary (5%); bumped token-bucket default 100->150 for internal clients
Devon: Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s on canary (api-gateway-demo); logs show short burst window exceeded
Devon: Today: triage logs, prepare PR for a soft-fail fallback route, coordinate with infra if rollback needed
Anika: saw the 429s ~09:12 UTC, added a small diag snippet — looks like KV cache misses amplify latency under burst
Anika: suggestion: drop canary to 1% and run a short ramp for 30m to validate
Kyle: can you drop a PR link? will quick-review
Devon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 — small change: adds fallback route + simple circuit-breaker on policy evaluation
Maria: Reviewing now, left two minor comments about metric labels and log context
Maria: also: auth team has a JWT KID rotation tonight — make sure canary clients are pointed at new JWKS URL
Devon: noted — canary currently uses the old issuer; will sync with ops-bot before rotation
ops-bot: Deployment schedule: auth JWT rotation planned for 23:00 UTC; will post rollout webhook ~30m prior and on completion
Anika: recommend lowering token-bucket to 80 for canary traffic for the next hour to reduce burst pressure
Kyle: for repro, can you paste a minimal curl?
Anika: curl example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=rw-1" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
```

Anika: run that with a short loop to reproduce the burst pattern
Devon: thanks — will run the ramp locally and tail /metrics and logs
Maria: LGTM on the PR after the comments addressed, tagging Kyle for a quick safety pass on the circuit-breaker behavior
Kyle: +1 on rollback plan. If 429s persist after reducing canary, revert policy commit: `git revert 1a2b3c` and reapply previous config
Devon: Plan of action now: 1) reduce canary to 1% 2) set token-bucket to 80 for canary 3) monitor 30m with alert at 3% 429s over 5m 4) revert if no improvement
Anika: I'll set a temporary dashboard alert and watch the infra traces
Maria: will re-review once changes are pushed, should be quick
Devon: anyone blocked by me? (what I did: pushed canary; blocker: 429s)
Kyle: not blocked, will do the quick pass within 15m
Anika: ping here if you need a rollback flip — I can do it asap
Devon: thanks team :thumbsup:
